custom_expected: Modal labels: Admin, Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Manager, Parts Tech, Office, Sales Representative, Time Clock. List labels: Administrator, Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Manager, Parts Technician, Office, Sales Representative, Time Clock User. Three labels differ (Admin↔Administrator, Parts Tech↔Parts Technician, Time Clock↔Time Clock User). Decision needed from product on whether this is intentional or a bug.
custom_preconds: On Roles list. Click 'Create custom role' to open the Choose a template modal.
custom_steps:
1. In the Choose a template modal, scroll through all 11 templates.
  2. Note the displayed label for each.
  3. Close the modal (X or Skip or Apply).
  4. On the Roles list, note the displayed label for each system role row.
  5. Compare modal labels to list labels.
  6. Identify discrepancies: Modal 'Admin' vs List 'Administrator'; Modal 'Parts Tech' vs List 'Parts Technician'; Modal 'Time Clock' vs List 'Time Clock User'.
  7. .
title: Choose a template modal uses short labels (Admin / Parts Tech / Time Clock) while Roles list uses long labels (Administrator / Parts Technician / Time Clock User)
